interpretations: For every ID in `MediaType`, include media types with no tracks; divide each type’s average `Track.UnitPrice` by the average `Track.UnitPrice` across all tracks. Show the top 10 ratios in descending order, with missing ratios last and no rounding.

For each `MediaTypeId` that appears in `Track`, divide that type’s average `Track.UnitPrice` by the average `Track.UnitPrice` across all tracks. Show the top 10 ratios in descending order, with missing ratios last and no rounding.

For every ID in `MediaType`, divide its average `Track.UnitPrice` by the unweighted average of the media types’ average track prices. Show the top 10 ratios in descending order, with missing ratios last and no rounding.

For each `MediaTypeId` that appears in `Track`, divide that type’s average `Track.UnitPrice` by the unweighted average of the media types’ average track prices. Show the top 10 ratios in descending order, with missing ratios last and no rounding.
queries:
SELECT
    m.MediaTypeId,
    AVG(t.UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio
FROM MediaType AS m
LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) / (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM Track) AS ratio
FROM Track
GROUP BY MediaTypeId
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH media_averages AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(t.UnitPrice) AS average_price
  FROM MediaType AS m
  LEFT JOIN Track AS t ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId
)
SELECT
  MediaTypeId,
  average_price / AVG(average_price) OVER () AS ratio
FROM media_averages
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH media_type_prices AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM Track
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT MediaTypeId,
         avg_price / (SELECT AVG(avg_price) FROM media_type_prices) AS ratio
  FROM media_type_prices
)
SELECT MediaTypeId, ratio
FROM ratios
ORDER BY ratio IS NULL, ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
